description: This Kotlin source file defines the ContentInfoActivity class, which displays details about a specific media content, fetches additional info from a server, and manages media playback using ExoPlayer. It handles UI rendering, network requests, and user interactions such as toggling fullscreen mode and initiating playback.
external_files: R (resources, including strings, colors, dimens, drawable placeholders)

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: Main activity class responsible for showing content details and managing media playback, including fetching data, handling UI interactions, and controlling ExoPlayer playback.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, loads poster image, sets up click handlers, and fetches content info based on intent extras.

methods.name: wirePlayerControls
methods.description: Binds controller buttons in the PlayerView for settings and fullscreen toggling.

methods.name: attachControllerListenersIfPresent
methods.description: Finds and attaches click listeners to the fullscreen and settings buttons inside the player controls.

methods.name: toggleFullscreen
methods.description: Switches between fullscreen and normal modes by hiding system UI and adjusting layout parameters.

methods.name: onSettingsClicked
methods.description: Stub handler for settings button; currently shows a toast message.

methods.name: fetchInfo
methods.description: Fetches media content details from the server to populate UI with title and description.

methods.name: onWatchNowClicked
methods.description: Requests the playback URL from the server, then triggers media playback.

methods.name: startPlayback
methods.description: Sets up ExoPlayer with the media URL, prepares, and starts playback; also manages UI state.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Pauses media playback when activity stops.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases ExoPlayer resources upon activity destruction.
